from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u037/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
path=programs/'task-a1b417f4.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}, key=lambda c: min(j for i, row in enumerate(grid) for j, v in enumerate(row) if v == c))
    shapes = []
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(i, j) for i, row in enumerate(grid) for j, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        r0, r1 = min(i for i, j in cells), max(i for i, j in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(j for i, j in cells), max(j for i, j in cells)
        shapes.append([[grid[i][j] if grid[i][j] == color else 0 for j in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for i in range(r0, r1 + 1)])
    height = max(len(shape) for shape in shapes)
    width = sum(len(row) for shape in shapes for row in shape[:1])
    out = [[0] * width for _ in range(height)]
    offset = 0
    for shape in shapes:
        h, w = len(shape), len(shape[0])
        for i in range(h):
            for j in range(w):
                out[i][offset + j] = shape[i][j]
        offset += w
    return out
'''
path.write_text(source)
print(path)
